text:
Aisha N.: FYI — NorthForge wants to spin up 3 new product squads (Search, Docs, Live Assist) using embeddings + realtime summarization. CS intake this AM — potential ~4x QPS in the next 6 weeks.

Liam C.: Do we have any hard numbers from the intake? rough token/QPS profile?

Aisha N.: From call notes: Search ~120 qps (avg 50 tokens), Docs embeddings batch jobs ~30 qps (avg 800 tokens per request), Live Assist spikey to ~300 qps (avg 30 tokens) during peak. They want summary latency <200ms for Live Assist.

Priya S.: We should schedule enablement + prompt-template workshop. I can run a session with their ML infra and docs team next Tue.

Jorge M.: Heads up — renewal in ~3 months. This expansion will materially change ARR and SLA conversation. I'll prep upsell + pilot package options.

Nina R.: For <200ms we should consider Dedicated pilot + KV caching and a low-latency model variant. Also recommend prefix caching for Live Assist. Pinging eng-infra for feasibility.

eng-oncall-bot: Deploy queue snapshot: length=7. Est slot availability in EMEA GPU pool: 2026-09-10.

Liam C.: Can someone paste expected sustained qps per route and burst profile so we can map to routing policies? We'll probably route Search -> cost-optimized model, LiveAssist -> low-latency variant.

Aisha N.: Quick numbers block for planning:
```
Search: 120 qps @ 50t avg
DocsEmbeds: 30 qps batch @ 800t avg
LiveAssist: 300 qps spikes @ 30t avg (bursty)
Total est tokens/day: ~45M
```

Priya S.: :calendar: I'll create the training invite and collect prompt sets + eval prompts from their team. Who owns the internal playbook for embeddings ops?

Jorge M.: I'll loop in finance for a cost estimate and add a proposed expansion clause to the renewal deck. Needs rough per-token and Dedicated monthly.

Nina R.: Action items (quick):
- @eng-infra: can you confirm Dedicated capacity and latency SLOs for LiveAssist? (owner: Nina)
- @product-ops: can we run a regional canary rollout plan? (owner: Liam)
- @finance: rough per-token cost + commit sizing for 45M tokens/day projection (owner: Jorge)
- @Priya S.: enablement session + prompt templates + eval harness (owner: Priya)

eng-infra: noted — will assess GPU pool and KV cache config, expect reply EOD tomorrow.

finance: will model cost scenarios, need expected commit horizon (3/6/12 months).

Liam C.: I'll draft routing policy proposal and fallback to cheaper model for non-critical routes.

Aisha N.: I'll update the account plan and create an expansion ticket. Adding screenshots from the intake and the slide notes. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

Priya S.: cool — I'll gather prompt examples and a short checklist for the workshop.

Jorge M.: tagging renewal owner to watch this thread. Let's sync 1:1 later today.

Nina R.: If eng-infra flags capacity constraints we can propose staged rollout (Search+Docs first, LiveAssist as canary).

Aisha N.: Assigning owners in the ticket. I'll follow up with a status update on Friday.
__notes: Single-thread Slack export styled doc. Messages are in chronological order and kept short to match Slack tone. No title field included per agents.md guidelines.
